data.title: Donald Trump optimistic on Iran deal, says Strait of Hormuz is 'sort of open' | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: On Wednesday, the White House refuted reports that Trump and US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth had argued about a lack of munitions in the wake of the war with Iran.
